uniform_system_suffix: Return valid JSON. Each imports item must be a name string, not an object.
response_model_boundary: Complete responses report deepseek-flash. Wire and response identifiers are recorded; actual deployed weights are not independently established.
normalization_import_semantics: Raw import object must equal the exact module/imported_name/name projection of one permitted binding. The fixed host source_path is restored from that same permitted binding in candidate.imports. No arbitrary import object is accepted.

part1_review_attribution.actual_scope: Implementation agent performed all eight manual reviews. N/P agents cross-checked their cases. Root had read mechanical counts and the complete N01 row, with further spot checks pending at time of this audit. Root-plus-implementer does not claim root personally re-read all eight cases.
part1_review_attribution.recommendation: When summarizing, use implementer review plus N/P cross-check and root spot-check; do not describe it as a blind independent audit.

semicolon_supplement_integrity.scope: Only format recovery integrity. No semantic correctness or target-program result judgment. Named AST equality alone is not a general semantic proof; exact unchanged test bytes except final whitespace/semicolon provide the stronger guarantee here.
